subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 00/10] nfsdctl: allow it to handle rpcbind registration and deregistration

reviews.author: Steve Dickson
reviews.summary: reviewer pointed out that the patch does not handle the case where rpcbind registration fails, and suggested adding error handling to deal with this scenario

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patchset allows the nfsdctl utility to handle rpcbind registration and deregistration, rather than relying on the kernel to do so. It introduces a new NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_USERSPACE_RPCBIND flag that tells the kernel not to register with rpcbind, and instead calls out to rpcbind using libtirpc client interfaces. The patchset also includes various bug fixes and improvements to nfsdctl's functionality.
